why.title: Built to be learned
why.subtitle: Nuru keeps the ideas of programming and drops the jargon.

features.title: Simple syntax
features.details: A small, consistent grammar you can hold in your head. A gentle first language, and a fast one to pick up if you already code.

features.title: Words you already know
features.details: andika() to print, jaza() to read input, kama for if. You read a program almost like a sentence.

features.title: Zero setup
features.details: The whole language runs in your browser through WebAssembly. Open a tab and start writing, no install.

keywords.title: Plain words, real code
keywords.subtitle: Every keyword is an everyday Swahili word.

learn.title: A path from zero to confident
learn.subtitle: Interactive lessons that run in the browser and check your work as you go.

tiers.name: The basics
tiers.blurb: Printing, variables, input, and your first loops and conditions.

tiers.name: Real programs
tiers.blurb: Functions, arrays, and logic to build things that actually do work.

tiers.name: Projects
tiers.blurb: Pull it all together and build complete programs in Nuru.

community.title: Made by a community
community.subtitle: Nuru is open source and shaped in the open. Your voice matters, and we consult the community before big decisions.
